current_activity: The 18th Volksgrenadier Division, on the Schnee Eifel, attacks north and south of the ridge
notes: Event date: CMH Ardennes ch. 7 p. 142: "the 18th Volks Grenadier Division, was holding the section of the West Wall along the northern reaches of the Schnee Eifel"; "made the 18th Volks Grenadier Division responsible for a concentric attack moving north and south of the Schnee Eifel"; Nafziger 944GLAA (15 December 1944): "18th Volks Grenadier Division: Oberst Hoffman-Schonborn". Event definition: the opening of the offensive on 16 December. Event support: two source families: CMH and Nafziger. Location: the Schnee Eifel ridge with a precision of 10 km, the ridge the division held and attacked around. Location approximate: a ridge point. Location support: CMH names the ridge. Commander: Generalmajor Günther Hoffmann-Schönborn. Opponents: US VIII Corps (106th Infantry Division).
